WITH /* isry.itgcm.bizcmmns.cmmns.RqstCoursMapper.selectRqstCoursList(의뢰경로목조회) */ V_CMMNS_DTL AS ( /* 접수의뢰경로구분코드 조회 */ SELECT SUBSTR(T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,1,2) AS LCLAS_VL_CD -- 접수의뢰경로대분류구분코드값 , SUBSTR(T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,1,4) AS MLSFC_VL_CD -- 접수의뢰경로중분류구분코드값 , SUBSTR(T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,1,6) AS SCLAS_VL_CD -- 접수의뢰경로소분류구분코드값 , T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS DTL_VL_CD -- 접수의뢰경로구분코드값 FROM SAC000 T21 /* 공통코드 */ , SAC100 T22 /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD' AND T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = T22.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) ORDER BY T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE ) , V_CMMNS_SCLAS AS ( /* 접수의뢰경로소분류구분코드 조회 */ SELECT SUBSTR(T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,1,2) AS LCLAS_VL_CD -- 접수의뢰경로대분류구분코드값 , SUBSTR(T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,1,4) AS MLSFC_VL_CD -- 접수의뢰경로중분류구분코드값 , T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS SCLAS_VL_CD -- 접수의뢰경로소분류구분코드값 , NULL AS DTL_VL_CD -- 접수의뢰경로구분코드값 FROM SAC000 T21 /* 공통코드 */ , SAC100 T22 /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_CD' AND T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = T22.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) ORDER BY T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE ) , V_CMMNS_MLSFC AS ( /* 접수의뢰경로중분류구분코드 조회 */ SELECT SUBSTR(T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,1,2) AS LCLAS_VL_CD -- 접수의뢰경로대분류구분코드값 , T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS MLSFC_VL_CD -- 접수의뢰경로중분류구분코드값 , NULL AS SCLAS_VL_CD -- 접수의뢰경로소분류구분코드값 , NULL AS DTL_VL_CD -- 접수의뢰경로구분코드값 FROM SAC000 T21 /* 공통코드 */ , SAC100 T22 /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_CD' AND T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = T22.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) ORDER BY T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE ) , V_CMMNS_LCLAS AS ( /* 접수의뢰경로대분류구분코드 조회 */ SELECT T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS LCLAS_VL_CD -- 접수의뢰경로대분류구분코드값 , NULL AS MLSFC_VL_CD -- 접수의뢰경로중분류구분코드값 , NULL AS SCLAS_VL_CD -- 접수의뢰경로소분류구분코드값 , NULL AS DTL_VL_CD -- 접수의뢰경로구분코드값 FROM SAC000 T21 /* 공통코드 */ , SAC100 T22 /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = T22.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) ORDER BY T22.CMMNS_CD_VALUE ) , V_CMMNS_LIST AS ( SELECT T11.LCLAS_VL_CD AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_CD -- 접수의뢰경로대분류구분코드값 , T11.MLSFC_VL_CD AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_CD -- 접수의뢰경로중분류구분코드값 , T11.SCLAS_VL_CD AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_CD -- 접수의뢰경로소분류구분코드값 , T11.DTL_VL_CD AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD -- 접수의뢰경로구분코드값 , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY T11.LCLAS_VL_CD) AS LCLAS_VL_CNT , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY T11.LCLAS_VL_CD, T11.MLSFC_VL_CD) AS MLSFC_VL_CNT , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY T11.LCLAS_VL_CD, T11.MLSFC_VL_CD, T11.SCLAS_VL_CD) AS SCLAS_VL_CNT FROM ( SELECT T21.LCLAS_VL_CD AS LCLAS_VL_CD , T21.MLSFC_VL_CD AS MLSFC_VL_CD , T21.SCLAS_VL_CD AS SCLAS_VL_CD , T21.DTL_VL_CD AS DTL_VL_CD FROM V_CMMNS_DTL T21 WHERE 1 = 1 UNION ALL SELECT T21.LCLAS_VL_CD AS LCLAS_VL_CD , T21.MLSFC_VL_CD AS MLSFC_VL_CD , T21.SCLAS_VL_CD AS SCLAS_VL_CD , T21.DTL_VL_CD AS DTL_VL_CD FROM V_CMMNS_SCLAS T21 WHERE 1 = 1 UNION ALL SELECT T21.LCLAS_VL_CD AS LCLAS_VL_CD , T21.MLSFC_VL_CD AS MLSFC_VL_CD , T21.SCLAS_VL_CD AS SCLAS_VL_CD , T21.DTL_VL_CD AS DTL_VL_CD FROM V_CMMNS_MLSFC T21 WHERE 1 = 1 UNION ALL SELECT T21.LCLAS_VL_CD AS LCLAS_VL_CD , T21.MLSFC_VL_CD AS MLSFC_VL_CD , T21.SCLAS_VL_CD AS SCLAS_VL_CD , T21.DTL_VL_CD AS DTL_VL_CD FROM V_CMMNS_LCLAS T21 WHERE 1 = 1 ) T11 WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY T11.LCLAS_VL_CD, T11.MLSFC_VL_CD, T11.SCLAS_VL_CD, T11.DTL_VL_CD ORDER BY T11.LCLAS_VL_CD, T11.MLSFC_VL_CD, T11.SCLAS_VL_CD, T11.DTL_VL_CD ) , V_COURS_LIST AS ( SELECT T1.RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_CD AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_CD -- 접수의뢰경로대분류구분코드 , ( SELECT X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 X WHERE X.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T1.RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_CD ) AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_NM , T1.RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_CD AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_CD -- 접수의뢰경로중분류구분코드 , ( SELECT X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 X WHERE X.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_CD' AND X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T1.RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_CD ) AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_NM , T1.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_CD AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_CD -- 접수의뢰경로소분류구분코 , ( SELECT X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 X WHERE X.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_CD' AND X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T1.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_CD ) AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_NM , T1.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD -- 접수의뢰경로구분코드 , ( SELECT X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 X WHERE X.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD' AND X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T1.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD ) AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_NM FROM V_CMMNS_LIST T1 WHERE 1 = 1 AND ((T1.LCLAS_VL_CNT = 1) OR (T1.LCLAS_VL_CNT > 1 AND T1.RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_CD IS NOT NULL)) AND ((T1.MLSFC_VL_CNT = 1) OR (T1.MLSFC_VL_CNT > 1 AND T1.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_CD IS NOT NULL)) AND ((T1.SCLAS_VL_CNT = 1) OR (T1.SCLAS_VL_CNT > 1 AND T1.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD IS NOT NULL)) ) SELECT T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_CD AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_CD -- 접수의뢰경로대분류구분코드 , T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_NM AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_NM , T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_CD AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_CD -- 접수의뢰경로중분류구분코드 , T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_NM AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_NM , T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_CD AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_CD -- 접수의뢰경로소분류구분코 , T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_NM AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_NM , T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD -- 접수의뢰경로구분코드 , T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_NM AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_NM FROM V_COURS_LIST T WHERE 1 = 1
AND T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_CD} -- 접수의뢰경로대분류구분코드
AND T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_CD = #{RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_CD} -- 접수의뢰경로중분류구분코드
AND T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_CD = #{RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_CD} -- 접수의뢰경로소분류구분코
AND ( T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD = #{RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD} -- 접수의뢰경로구분코드 OR T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_NM LIKE '%' || #{RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD} || '%' ) -- 접수의뢰경로구분명
AND T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_NM LIKE '%' || #{RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_NM} || '%' -- 접수의뢰경로구분명
/* 접수의뢰경로 대분류 단위업무 확인*/ AND ((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SAC110 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_CD) = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SAC110 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_CD AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD})) /* 접수의뢰경로 중분류 단위업무 확인*/ AND ((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SAC110 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_CD) = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SAC110 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_CD AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD})) /* 접수의뢰경로 소분류 단위업무 확인*/ AND ((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SAC110 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_CD) = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SAC110 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_CD AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD})) /* 접수의뢰경로 세분류 단위업무 확인*/ AND ((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SAC110 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD) = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SAC110 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}))
ORDER BY T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_LCLAS_SE_CD, T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_MLSFC_SE_CD, T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SCLAS_SE_CD, T.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD
